summary: Iter 369 — restore-drill automation + ad-click attribution join. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests PASS (test_iter369_restore_drill_and_ad_attribution.py). All 4 backup endpoints verified: /admin/backups/drill-now runs a REAL restore (46k+ docs / 138 collections, coverage=1.0, ~8s), writes a row to restore_drill_history; /admin/backups/drill-history returns full shape (ok/history/last_ok_at/last_fail_at/last_result); /admin/backups/run and /admin/backups/test-restore untouched regressions PASS. Ad-attribution end-to-end verified: POST /ads/attribute-click with gclid=test123/utm=google/campaign=launch returns ok:true first time and ok:false reason='already attributed' second time (first-touch idempotent). GET /admin/users/{id} returns ad_attribution field with gclid/utm/landing_path. GET /admin/insights/activation-funnel/stage-users?stage=signed_up returns the row with ad_source='Google Ads'. Activation Funnel bottleneck_summary/stuck_counts/biggest_bottleneck_stage regression fields present. Frontend: (1) Landing with ?gclid=xxx&utm_source=google&utm_campaign=launch writes {gclid, utm_source, utm_campaign, landing_path} to localStorage 'aurem_ad_attr'; revisiting with a DIFFERENT gclid does NOT overwrite (first-touch preserved); plain landing without params leaves localStorage clean; ZERO console errors on any of these paths. (2) /admin/overview shows new backup-health-card below db-health-card with BACKUP OK pill ('last success 2m ago') and RESTORE DRILL OK pill ('45981 docs / 138 colls restored · checked 2m ago') — real live data. (3) Funnel modal (click funnel-count-signed_up) opens funnel-stage-users-modal and renders the 'VIA GOOGLE ADS' badge (data-testid=funnel-stage-user-ad-source-0) next to the attributed user. (4) Backend startup logs confirm '🧪 restore-drill cron enabled (every 604800s ≈ 7.0 days)' — cron IS registered at boot. (5) No 'WILL fail' scare language in backup_tools boot log — 'found mongodump/mongorestore at /bin/...' clean message. (6) '[G6] onboarding_emails: removed' does NOT appear on restart (only 'ensured index uniq_user_campaign_stage'). UserDetail banner code verified via source grep (data-testid='admin-user-ad-attribution' conditionally renders on d.ad_attribution) — could not click through UI because /admin/users list only shows users with activity, but backend API confirms ad_attribution field is delivered to that endpoint. All assertions passed with real data; no mocks/placeholders anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOverview.jsx and Admin.jsx are both >2000 lines — the earlier maintainability note stands (extract BackupHealthCard, StageUsersModal, UserDetail cards to their own files). Not blocking.

Admin.jsx UserDetail is only reachable by clicking a row in the /admin/users listing, which only lists users with agent activity — an admin cannot open the detail page for a brand-new signup that has no tasks yet. Consider allowing direct URL access via /admin/users/{id} or a search box that surfaces zero-activity users. Not a bug for this batch but limits QA verifiability of the ad_attribution banner from the UI.

engagement.py: attribute_ad_click stores only whatever keys are present in payload — if a caller sends only landing_path (no gclid/fbclid/utm_*), we still persist landing_path alone. That means a user visiting '/' with no ad params but the frontend still POSTing '/' will lock them into a bogus 'unknown' ad_attribution. Recommend requiring at least one of gclid/fbclid/utm_source before writing — check the frontend guard actually prevents this call when localStorage is empty.
restore-drill cron: default period is 604800s (7 days) but there is no visible next-run timestamp exposed via drill-history — consider adding `next_scheduled_at` for admin observability.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 disposable signups (test+adattr*@aurem.dev) — both cleaned up via DELETE /admin/users/{id} at end.
